''There appears to be some sort of research station near a pulsar, although it's hard to tell since a portion of it has been melted. The Lanius ship that has been working at it moves in to intercept you, totally oblivious to the threat of EM pulses.''
*Fight a [[Lanius Ships|Lanius ship]] ([[Rewards#Default_rewards:_Lanius|default Lanius rewards]]). <ref name="Enemy ship (LANIUS_SHIP)">{{SurrenderEscape(alt)|escape+surrender|LANIUS_SHIP|dlcEvents_anaerobic.xml|80|20-40|2-4|80|30-40|3-4}}</ref>

==Notes==
This event is called "LANIUS_FIGHT_PULSAR" in the datafiles.
